title: Tiny, cute helicopter
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Main rotor blur / disc -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="22" rx="38" ry="5" fill="#5BC8F5" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Rotor blades -->
  <rect x="10" y="20" width="80" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#7FE0FF"/>
  <!-- Rotor hub -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="22" r="4" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="22" r="2" fill="#FFF176"/>
  <!-- Rotor mast -->
  <rect x="48" y="24" width="4" height="8" fill="#FFB74D"/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="28" ry="20" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <!-- Body top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="20" ry="10" fill="#81D4FA" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Cockpit window -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="16" ry="12" fill="#B3E5FC"/>
  <!-- Window glow -->
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="48" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#E1F5FE" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- Eyes on window -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="53" r="3.5" fill="#1A237E"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="53" r="3.5" fill="#1A237E"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="52" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="52" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Cute smile -->
  <path d="M45 59 Q50 63 55 59" stroke="#1A237E" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Tail boom -->
  <rect x="72" y="52" width="16" height="6" rx="3" fill="#5BC8F5"/>
  <!-- Tail rotor hub -->
  <circle cx="88" cy="55" r="4" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <!-- Tail rotor blades -->
  <rect x="84" y="45" width="3" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#7FE0FF"/>
  <rect x="84" y="59" width="3" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#7FE0FF"/>
  <rect x="84" y="52" width="8" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#7FE0FF" transform="rotate(90 88 55)"/>
  <!-- Tail fin -->
  <rect x="80" y="48" width="4" height="14" rx="2" fill="#FFB74D"/>
  <!-- Landing skids -->
  <rect x="28" y="74" width="44" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#FFB74D"/>
  <rect x="32" y="70" width="3" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#FFB74D"/>
  <rect x="65" y="70" width="3" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#FFB74D"/>
  <!-- Little wheels -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="77" r="3" fill="#FF8A65"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="77" r="3" fill="#FF8A65"/>
  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="58" r="3" fill="#FF8A80" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="58" r="3" fill="#FF8A80" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
